name: Siyuan Liu
title: Computational Mechanics & Simulation Engineer
tagline: I develop numerical models to understand how materials respond, evolve, and fail under coupled physical fields.
intro: Working at the intersection of solid mechanics, energy materials, and scientific computing — from the governing equations to robust numerical solutions.
about_p1: My work explores the mechanics of materials and structures under coupled thermal, chemical, and mechanical loading. I am especially interested in the transition from stress development to damage and fracture.
about_p2: I enjoy connecting physical models with reliable numerical implementations: finite element formulations, nonlinear equilibrium solvers, sparse linear algebra, and clear scientific visualizations.

focus.label: SCIENTIFIC COMPUTING
focus.detail: Python · MATLAB · C++ · Sparse numerical solvers
